Field group

Source: R/tier2-form-field.R
shad_field_group.Rd

Experimental. Arranges shad_form_field() children vertically, horizontally, or responsively inside a container-query-aware group.

Usage

shad_field_group(
  ...,
  orientation = c("vertical", "horizontal", "responsive"),
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

...

Child fields and/or named HTML attributes.

orientation

"vertical" (default), "horizontal", or "responsive".

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A

field-group tag.

See also

Other shadshiny forms: shad_field_separator(), shad_fieldset(), shad_form_counter(), shad_form_message(), shad_form_summary(), shad_rules, shad_validator(), update_shad_form_field()
